name: seal-motion
js: const sec = document.querySelector('#seal-chain'); const st = () => [sec.className, sec.querySelector('.sc-status').textContent.slice(0, 40), sec.querySelector('.sc-press').textContent, sec.querySelector('.sc-press').disabled, sec.querySelector('.sc-tamper').disabled, sec.querySelectorAll('.sc-slot.is-sealed').length, sec.querySelectorAll('.sc-pin.is-up').length, sec.querySelectorAll('.sc-link.is-on').length, sec.querySelector('.sc-gate').className, [...sec.querySelectorAll('.sc-slot-bytes')].map(b => b.textContent).join(','), sec.querySelector('.sc-wallet').style.opacity, sec.querySelector('.sc-rows').textContent.slice(30, 80)].join(' | '); const out = [st()]; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { sec.querySelector('.sc-press').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3500)); out.push(st()); } sec.querySelector('.sc-tamper').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3500)); out.push(st()); sec.querySelector('.sc-reset').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); out.push(st()); return out;
